description: Synthetic rollback plans. G* are acceptable (G7 is acceptable but flagged for the owner); B* each have one seeded defect. No real data.

cases.why: normal R2 config change with a scratch test

plan.action: Change the Saturday weighting in the forecast brain rule from 1.0 to 1.1
steps: Open the brain-rule file in version control and find the Saturday weighting key.
Set the Saturday weighting back to 1.0 and commit the change with the message 'revert weighting'.
plan.test_step: Run the forecast on a saved Saturday input in a scratch copy and confirm it reproduces the old quantities.

cases.why: normal R2 skill install

plan.action: Install the reviewed skill sample-notes into .claude/skills
steps: Remove the folder .claude/skills/sample-notes in a new commit.
Push the commit to the working branch and wait for the check to finish.
plan.test_step: List the skills in a temporary clone and confirm sample-notes no longer appears.

cases.why: normal R3 delete with backup

plan.action: Delete the superseded draft files in the shared drafts folder
steps: Copy the three files back from the dated backup folder into the drafts folder.
Compare each restored file's checksum with the one in the dry-run listing.
plan.test_step: Restore one file into a scratch folder and compare its checksum with the original.

backup.where: the dated backup folder next to drafts

cases.why: normal R4 post with a recall path

plan.action: Publish the queued Threads post for tomorrow
steps: Open the post in the Threads app on the shop account and choose delete.
Confirm the post no longer appears on the public profile page.
plan.test_step: Confirm in the app that a delete option exists on a prior post before relying on it.
plan.external_recall: Delete the post within minutes; viewers in that window may have seen it.

cases.why: normal R5 rotation instructions for the owner

plan.action: Ask the owner to rotate the supplier portal password
steps: Use the supplier's own reset page to set another password and revoke the old one.
Store the new password in the password manager only.
plan.test_step: Read the supplier's help article and confirm the reset page works before rotating.

cases.why: normal R6 cancel with refund

plan.action: Subscribe to a paid event-listings feed for the forecast
steps: Open the account page and cancel the subscription before the trial ends.
Ask support for a refund of the last charge and keep the confirmation.
plan.test_step: Read the cancellation terms and confirm a cancel button exists before subscribing.

cases.why: an irreversible R4 action is allowed only with a reason, and is flagged so the owner sees it

plan.action: Send the signed supplier agreement to the supplier
plan.test_step: Open the final attachment in the outgoing draft and confirm it is the signed version with no edits.

irreversible.why: A sent agreement cannot be recalled; the damage is limited because the owner reads it once more and the supplier has not countersigned.
